arguments.prompt:
Create a native pixel-art game animation SOURCE ATLAS of Earthworm Jim. EXACT INCARNATION: Earthworm Jim (1994), original video game. APPEARANCE: Pink earthworm head in bulky white super-suit, broad shoulders, blue gloves and boots, red belt; not the cartoon casual clothes.. EQUIPMENT/ROLE: his own worm body as a whip; small suit blaster for ordinary shot. NAMED SOURCE SUPER: Fouet du ver Jim. Fixed source incarnation; engine strengths/timing and cross-universe gameplay remain adapted.

Detailed clean16-bit pixel art, consistent three-quarter side view FACING RIGHT. STRICTLY48 complete independently drawn figures in EIGHT COLUMNS and SIX ROWS, 8x6. Every adjacent FOUR figures is a FOUR-POSE SEQUENCE. Each entire head, body, all native limbs, tail/feathers and complete equipment tips stay inside its own cell. Retain the same anatomy, proportions and outfit in every figure. Leave a CLEAR32-PIXEL OUTER MARGIN and generous transparent gutters between EVERY figure. Make figures slightly smaller to keep real transparent space. No overlapping parts or touching silhouettes. Transparent background, no grid/labels/text/numbers/scenery/ground/cast-shadow.

ROW1 columns1–4 INTRO: approach and ready with four distinct physical postures. Columns5–8 OUTRO: lower tools/hands, turn, depart, settle.
ROW2 columns1–4 ROUND VICTORY: four brief personality-correct acknowledgments. Columns5–8 ROUND LOSS: four disappointed/breathing/steady postures, unharmed.
ROW3 columns1–4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: Jim uses his own flexible pink worm body as a long whip while the white suit remains a complete coherent cartoon figure: windup, extend, full sweeping whip in THIRD pose, recover. No wounds or severed flesh; this is his non-graphic playable worm anatomy. Keep the entire worm tip inside the cell. Columns5–8 MATCH VICTORY: four distinct actual celebration postures DIFFERENT from round-win.
ROW4 columns1–4 MATCH LOSS: four unharmed disappointed or crouched/recovering physical postures. Columns5–8 SUPER: Jim uses his own flexible pink worm body as a long whip while the white suit remains a complete coherent cartoon figure: windup, extend, full sweeping whip in THIRD pose, recover. No wounds or severed flesh; this is his non-graphic playable worm anatomy. Keep the entire worm tip inside the cell. Four newly drawn poses different from row3.
ROW5 columns1–4 IDLE: four genuinely different breathing/weight/fin/feather/ear positions. Columns5–8 RUN: four true alternating locomotion strides, or swim/bob motion for the actual nonhuman anatomy.
ROW6 columns1–4 ORDINARY ACTION: Jim uses the small physically held suit BLASTER for the ordinary-action group only: ready, aim, tiny muzzle flash in THIRD pose, recover. No worm whip in this ordinary blaster group. Columns5–8 HIT REACTION: four non-graphic flinch/steady/recover poses, still complete and unharmed.

All48 are DIFFERENT DRAWINGS, not shifted, recoloured, mirrored or copied duplicates. No attack/flash outside the explicit attack groups. No blood, wound, victim, corpse, dismemberment, death or violence against another character. Non-graphic solo acting. These are newly drawn adaptations, not copied official sprite frames.
